summary: In the hall, cops flood the eighth floor, rushing everywhere. The scene is a brief burst of action: a group of police officers arrives en masse and spreads out across the floor.

what_changes.before: Not yet present on the eighth floor.
what_changes.after: They flood the eighth floor, rushing everywhere, establishing a police presence.
what_changes.evidence: Cops flood the eight floor, rushing everywhere.

event_hint.one_line: Police pour onto the eighth floor as part of the building-wide search.

uncertain: Whether the cops are looking for a specific target on the eighth floor.
Whether anyone is present on the floor for them to find.
